details.description:
When the protective layer of the teeth (enamel) wears away or the gums recede, the dentine underneath becomes exposed. When this exposed dentine comes into contact with hot, cold, sweet or sour food and drinks, it can trigger a sharp, short sensation known as tooth sensitivity.
Sensodyne Repair & Protect is a daily fluoride toothpaste that helps repair and protect the sensitive areas of the teeth, while still providing the benefits of a regular toothpaste, such as strong teeth and healthy gums. It is powered by NovaMin, a unique calcium formulation that helps repair sensitive areas using the natural building blocks of teeth. With every brush, the formulation builds ongoing protection, allowing you to enjoy your favourite foods and drinks without worrying about sensitivity.
Sensodyne Repair & Protect Deep Repair toothpaste is available in three pack sizes: 70 g, 100 g and a 140 g (70 g x 2) combo pack. Brushing twice daily helps protect against tooth sensitivity.
Always follow the instructions and guidance provided on the pack before use.
details.usageInstructions:
Use as your regular toothpaste.
Apply at least a 1-inch strip of the toothpaste onto a soft bristle toothbrush.
Brush teeth thoroughly for at least 2 minutes twice a day (morning and evening) and not more than 3 times a day or as recommended by the dentist.
Make sure to brush all the sensitive areas of the teeth.
Minimise swallowing, spit out after brushing.

details.description: Everyone wants a toothbrush which helps effectively clean their teeth. It is important for people, especially with sensitive teeth. Effective cleaning helps prevent plaque build-up and soft bristles minimise further wear and tear that can be caused by excessive brushing. The newest Sensodyne toothbrush - Complete Protection+ has all the features for gentle and effective cleaning of teeth. It has soft bristles that are end-rounded to be gentle on teeth. The outer bristles of the Sensodyne Complete Protection+ toothbrush are tapered filaments for superior interdental and gum line cleaning - offering 48% better cleaning. It is designed with a small compact head size and duo-flex neck. The small head size helps deliver better access to harder-to-reach areas within the oral cavity. The duo-flex neck allows for better access and protects tooth enamel against overbrushing by applying less pressure. In order to be environmentally friendly, the packaging material used is plastic free - made of cardboard or cellulose film and is recyclable.
details.usageInstructions:
Brush your teeth gently twice a day to avoid plaque build-up.
Please note, excessive bending may break the neck of the toothbrush. It is recommended to change your toothbrush every three months.
For optimal care of tooth sensitivity, we recommend brushing in combination with Sensodyne toothpaste twice a day.

details.description: The Sensodyne Deep Clean toothbrush is specially designed for gentle yet thorough cleaning of teeth. It has extra-soft, silky bristles that provide effective cleaning of teeth while being gentle on teeth and gums. The dense bristle base of the brush helps remove plaque effectively, while the micro-fine tapered filaments provide deep cleaning between the teeth (up to 38% better reach between the teeth) and along the gumline (up to 4 times better reach along the gumline) compared to a flat trim manual toothbrush.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Brush your teeth gently twice a day to avoid plaque build-up.
2. Do not brush too hard as applying too much pressure can lead to overbrushing.
3. It is recommended that toothbrushes be replaced every 3 months.
